title: purple-mimi 9: Windows i686 DLL for Pidgin 2.14
description: P7: the Windows build as its own step (docs/design/purple-mimi.md §13): i686-pc-windows-gnu or -msvc (purple-presage uses MSVC x86), aws-lc-sys on i686, LockFileEx for the state lock, a loopback socket pair for the event wake-up, state under %APPDATA%\.purple, CI and a release DLL. About 400 to 800 lines (estimate). After step 8.
